title: Preference for physical buttons over touchscreen controls
summary: Reviews in this topic focus on wanting proper physical buttons, especially for climate and other key functions, instead of relying on the touchscreen.

positive.summary: One positive review says physical buttons are needed for practical use while driving, particularly for air conditioning controls.

negative.summary: Negative reviews criticize the lack of physical buttons and say touchscreen-only controls for climate and key functions are irritating, distracting, and less effective.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews commonly express a preference for more tactile buttons, knobs, or dedicated controls for heating and other functions, but the examples are often too brief to classify sentiment confidently.

limitations: Most examples in this topic are undetermined, so the available evidence for clearly classified sentiment is limited.
The sampled fragments are heavily concentrated in one country and one model/engine configuration.
Several undetermined fragments are very short or phrased as preferences, which limits confident interpretation.
